title: Health Education — Grade 6-8 Learning Graph
description: A learning graph of 133 concepts covering the Grade 6-8 band of the Health Education intelligent textbook: Food and Nutrition; Human Growth, Development, and Sexual Health; Mental and Emotional Health; Personal Health and Wellness; Personal Safety and Violence Prevention; Substance Use Awareness and Prevention (new at this band); and cross-cutting Skill Standards. Derived from the 2025 Minnesota K-12 Health Academic Standards, Commissioner Approved.
creator: Dan McCreary
